hero.title: I'm SouL,
hero.subtitle: A Physics student and animation storyteller.
hero.description: Are you curious about me? maybe not. But i am feeling bored at 3am in the morning. So here it is, my digital footprint... A space that contains information on "meee" and interesting things i do.

tour.title: a quick tour, in case you're lost

cards.title: I, Me & Myself
cards.text: here you will find little bit of information about me, my world and what exactly i think of myself.

cards.title: Journal
cards.text: Blogs, thoughts, perspectives and a lot of think that goes on inside my head, so if you like you can read it.

cards.title: Memories
cards.text: Life around me has always been interesting, and i hope it always will be, coz these memories never die(hopefully).

cards.title: Influences
cards.text: All my life i have been obsessed over music, books, stories and movies... these are the things that shaped me for who i am today.

cards.title: Creations
cards.text: That urge to make something unique, i hope i will do that someday but till then these are projects i worked on.

cards.title: Archive
cards.text: You can search through everything in this website, it's a dumpyard of ideas, projects and memories.

notes: they say - You can't be kind to everyone... i can and i will be.
They got my story wrong, coz it was not me who told them. This time i will write it myself and i will be the storyteller.
